//: Credentials that must exist on the n8n instance before deploy. NEVER commit real values.
//how: Workflow JSON references __CRED__:<alias>; deploy.py resolves alias -> name -> real id via GET /api/v1/credentials.
//why-so-few: n8n holds no third-party credentials beyond those below. Staff notification goes through Core API's /internal/notify/*, so 10DLC, opt-out and consent enforcement live in one place and cannot be bypassed. Adding a Twilio node here would reintroduce that bypass.

required.setup: Header Auth. Name: Authorization. Value: Bearer <VAPI_API_KEY>
required.usedBy: WF-19, WF-20, WF-21, WF-22 — reading call records from api.vapi.ai

required.setup: Header Auth. Name: Authorization. Value: Bearer $GRACE_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN
required.usedBy: WF-12, WF-18 — dormant until Core API exists

deferred.status: SKELETON — the node exists in WF-20/21/22 but is disabled.
deferred.blocker: n8n Cloud cannot reach a database on a laptop; a hosted instance is required (Neon or Supabase free tier).
deferred.toEnable: Create the database, run platform/postgres/schema.sql, add a 'PalmLeaf Postgres (dev)' credential, enable the Archive node in each workflow, redeploy.
deferred.note: The linter deliberately permits an unresolved placeholder on a DISABLED node — that is what lets this ship switched off.

deferred.status: READY — create when Core API's worker starts calling n8n.
deferred.setup: Header Auth. Name: Authorization. Value: Bearer $GRACE_N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET (min 32 chars).
deferred.usedBy: WF-17 — verifies inbound worker calls. n8n checks this natively on the Webhook node.
deferred.note: Chosen over verifying an HMAC in a Code node, which cannot read the secret on n8n Cloud (Q-04.5).

deferred.status: BLOCKED — WF-26 is written and committed but SKIPPED at deploy until this credential exists.
deferred.blocker: Waiting on the client's email account and sending domain.
deferred.toEnable: Add the SMTP credential in n8n, set GRACE_REPORTS_EMAIL_TO in the deploy environment, redeploy.
deferred.usedBy: WF-26, called by WF-07 (nightly), WF-20 (daily), WF-21 (weekly), and WF-22 (only when a call is flagged) — WF-11 deliberately excluded to avoid an hourly email.
deferred.recipient: The To: address is NOT part of this credential. It comes from GRACE_REPORTS_EMAIL_TO, resolved by deploy.py at deploy time via the __EMAIL__:reports-to placeholder; unset blocks WF-26 rather than falling back.
